title: Solomon's Building Projects and the Division of the People
description: After twenty years, when Solomon had finished building the house of the Lord and his own palace, he rebuilt the towns that Hiram had given him. He marched to Hamath-Zobah and conquered it. He also built Tadmor in the wilderness and constructed store cities, chariot cities, and fortified cities such as Upper Beth Horon and Lower Beth Horon. To the descendants of the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites who remained in the land, he assigned forced labor. But the Israelites were not made to serve as slaves; instead, they served as soldiers, officers, commanders, chariot drivers, and horsemen. There were 250 overseers in charge of the work.
